verses.sloka: स सुग्रीवम् च ताराम् च स अंगदाम् सह लक्ष्मणः ।समान शोकः काकुत्स्थः सांत्वयन् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-२५-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa sugrīvam ca tārām ca sa aṁgadām saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।samāna śokaḥ kākutsthaḥ sāṁtvayan idam abravīt ॥4-25-1॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana were equally sad. Rama, scion of the Kakutstha race, consoled Sugriva, Tara as well as Angada in the following words:

verses.sloka: न शोक परितापेन श्रेयसा युज्यते मृतः ।यद् अत्र अनंतरम् कार्यम् तत् समाधातुम् अर्हथ ॥४-२५-२॥
verses.transliteration: na śoka paritāpena śreyasā yujyate mṛtaḥ ।yad atra anaṁtaram kāryam tat samādhātum arhatha ॥4-25-2॥

translations.english: 'No lamentation revives the dead. So you should take up whatever is required now.
translations.hindi: डस्ताचलगामी सूर्य की तरद तुम्हारा झुल वैसे हन हे जैसा कि, जीवत काल में दमकता था। देखो यह. पर तुमको परलोक में ले जाने के लिए खींच रहा है ॥४९ येन स्म विधवाः सर्वाः कृता एकेषुणा रणे# । इमास्तास्तव राजेन्द्र बानर्यो बहुभाः सदा

verses.sloka: लोक वृत्तम् अनुष्ठेयम् कृतम् वो बाष्प मोक्षणम् ।न कालाद् उत्तरम् किंचित् कर्म शक्यम् उपासितुम् ॥४-२५-३॥
verses.transliteration: loka vṛttam anuṣṭheyam kṛtam vo bāṣpa mokṣaṇam ।na kālād uttaram kiṁcit karma śakyam upāsitum ॥4-25-3॥

translations.english: 'You have to go the worldly way. You have shed tears enough. Time is passing. You cannot perform the funeral after the lapse of appropriate time.

verses.sloka: नियतिः कारणम् लोके नियतिः कर्म साधनम् ।नियतिः सर्व भूतानाम् नियोगेषु इह कारणम् ॥४-२५-४॥
verses.transliteration: niyatiḥ kāraṇam loke niyatiḥ karma sādhanam ।niyatiḥ sarva bhūtānām niyogeṣu iha kāraṇam ॥4-25-4॥

translations.english: 'Fate is the cause of the world. Fate is the means of accomplishment. Fate assigns duties to all beings.

verses.sloka: न कर्ता कस्यचित् कश्चित् नियोगे च अपि न ईश्वरः ।स्वभावे वर्तते लोकः तस्य कालः परायणम् ॥४-२५-५॥
verses.transliteration: na kartā kasyacit kaścit niyoge ca api na īśvaraḥ ।svabhāve vartate lokaḥ tasya kālaḥ parāyaṇam ॥4-25-5॥

translations.english: 'No one can control another's action. No one including God can be the agent of action. No one has the power to entrust duty to others. This entire world is governed by one's own nature. Nature in turn is governed by Time (fate).

verses.sloka: न कालः कालम् अत्येति न कालः परिहीयते ।स्वभावम् च समासाद्य न कश्चित् अतिवर्तते ॥४-२५-६॥
verses.transliteration: na kālaḥ kālam atyeti na kālaḥ parihīyate ।svabhāvam ca samāsādya na kaścit ativartate ॥4-25-6॥

translations.english: 'God (though independent) does not deviate from Time. Time cannot be escaped or trangressed. It cannot be condoned or avoided. No one can transgress their own nature.

verses.sloka: न कालस्य अस्ति बंधुत्वम् न हेतुर् न पराक्रमः ।न मित्र ज्ञाति संबन्धः कारणम् न आत्मनो वशः ॥४-२५-७॥
verses.transliteration: na kālasya asti baṁdhutvam na hetur na parākramaḥ ।na mitra jñāti saṁbandhaḥ kāraṇam na ātmano vaśaḥ ॥4-25-7॥

translations.english: 'Time has no consideration for relationship, friendship, or kinship or valour. Time itself is the cause. It is never under one's control.

verses.sloka: किम् तु काल परीणामो द्रष्टव्यः साधु पश्यता ।धर्मः च अर्थः च कामः च कालक्रम समाहिताः ॥४-२५-८॥
verses.transliteration: kim tu kāla parīṇāmo draṣṭavyaḥ sādhu paśyatā ।dharmaḥ ca arthaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca kālakrama samāhitāḥ ॥4-25-8॥

translations.english: 'However a wise man should visualise the turn of events in course of time with the right vision. Dharma, artha and kama are controlled by an order laid down by Time.

verses.sloka: इतः स्वाम् प्रकृतिम् वाली गतः प्राप्तः क्रिया फलम् ।साम दान अर्थ संयोगैः पवित्रम् प्लवग ईश्वर ॥४-२५-९॥
verses.transliteration: itaḥ svām prakṛtim vālī gataḥ prāptaḥ kriyā phalam ।sāma dāna artha saṁyogaiḥ pavitram plavaga īśvara ॥4-25-9॥

translations.english: 'Vali, king of monkeys is dead and gone. He acted according to his own nature and attained the sacred fruit of his action comensurate with dharma, wealth and pleasures in this world.

verses.sloka: स्व धर्मस्य च संयोगात् जितः तेन महात्मना ।स्वर्गः परिगृहीतः च प्राणान् अपरिरक्षता ॥४-२५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sva dharmasya ca saṁyogāt jitaḥ tena mahātmanā ।svargaḥ parigṛhītaḥ ca prāṇān aparirakṣatā ॥4-25-10॥

translations.english: 'Great Vali has earned a place in heaven by virtue of his own dharma and not caring for his own life .He has got the heavenly position he earned.

verses.sloka: एषा वै नियतिः श्रेष्ठा याम् गतो हरि यूथपः ।तत् अलम् परितापेन प्राप्त कालम् उपास्यताम् ॥४-२५-११॥
verses.transliteration: eṣā vai niyatiḥ śreṣṭhā yām gato hari yūthapaḥ ।tat alam paritāpena prāpta kālam upāsyatām ॥4-25-11॥

translations.english: 'The state attained by the chief of monkeys is an excellent one.Therefore there is no need to regret. Attend to your duties (relating to rites)'

verses.sloka: वचन अन्ते तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः पर वीर हा ।अवदत् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् गत चेतसम् ॥४-२५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: vacana ante tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīra hā ।avadat praśritam vākyam sugrīvam gata cetasam ॥4-25-12॥

translations.english: Seeing Sugriva had lost his senses, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemy warriors humbly said at the end of Rama's address:

verses.sloka: कुरु त्वम् अस्य सुग्रीव प्रेत कार्यम् अनंतरम् ।तारा अंगदाभ्याम् सहितो वालिनो दहनम् प्रति ॥४-२५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: kuru tvam asya sugrīva preta kāryam anaṁtaram ।tārā aṁgadābhyām sahito vālino dahanam prati ॥4-25-13॥

translations.english: 'O Sugriva perform with Tara and Angada the funeral obsequies relating to the cremation of Vali.

verses.sloka: समाज्ञापय काष्ठानि शुष्काणि च बहूनि च ।चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि वालि संस्कार कारणात् ॥४-२५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: samājñāpaya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇi ca bahūni ca ।candanāni ca divyāni vāli saṁskāra kāraṇāt ॥4-25-14॥

translations.english: 'Let the best of dry logs and sandalwood be ordered for the funeral rites of Vali.

verses.sloka: समाश्वासय दीनम् त्वम् अंगदम् दीन चेतसम् ।मा भूः बालिश बुद्धिः त्वम् त्वत् अधीनम् इदम् पुरम् ॥४-२५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: samāśvāsaya dīnam tvam aṁgadam dīna cetasam ।mā bhūḥ bāliśa buddhiḥ tvam tvat adhīnam idam puram ॥4-25-15॥

translations.english: 'Pacify the despondent Angada so that he does not entertain childish thoughts any more. This city is under your control (now).

verses.sloka: अंगदः तु आनयेत् माल्यम् वस्त्राणि विविधानि च ।घृतम् तैलम् अथो गन्धान् यत् च अत्र समनंतरम् ॥४-२५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: aṁgadaḥ tu ānayet mālyam vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ।ghṛtam tailam atho gandhān yat ca atra samanaṁtaram ॥4-25-16॥

translations.english: 'Let Angada for his part collect garlands of many kinds, clothes, clarified butter, oil, fragrants and all that is required to be procured.

verses.sloka: त्वम् तार शिबिकाम् शीघ्रम् आदाय आगच्छ संभ्रमात् ।त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता हि अस्मिन् काले विशेषतः ॥४-२५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tvam tāra śibikām śīghram ādāya āgaccha saṁbhramāt ।tvarā guṇavatī yuktā hi asmin kāle viśeṣataḥ ॥4-25-17॥

translations.english: 'O Tara quickly get a swiftmoving litter fastened with ropes specially suitable for this occasion.

verses.sloka: सज्जी भवन्तु प्लवगाः शिबिक वाहन उचिताः ।समर्था बलिनः चैव निर्हरिष्यन्ति वालिनम् ॥४-२५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: sajjī bhavantu plavagāḥ śibika vāhana ucitāḥ ।samarthā balinaḥ caiva nirhariṣyanti vālinam ॥4-25-18॥

translations.english: 'Let those who are strong and capable among the monkeys be ready to carry the dead body of Vali on a litter'.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवम् सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनः ।तस्थौ भ्रातृ समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः पर वीरहा ॥४-२५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu sugrīvam sumitra ānanda vardhanaḥ ।tasthau bhrātṛ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīrahā ॥4-25-19॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken to Sugriva, Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, slayer of enemies, stood by his brother

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारः संभ्रान्त मानसः ।प्रविवेश गुहाम् शीघ्रम् शिबिका आसक्त मानसः ॥४-२५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tāraḥ saṁbhrānta mānasaḥ ।praviveśa guhām śīghram śibikā āsakta mānasaḥ ॥4-25-20॥

translations.english: On hearing Lakshmana, Tara in an excited state quickly entered the cave city to get the litter.

verses.sloka: आदाय शिबिकाम् तारः स तु पर्यापयत् पुनः ।वानरैः उह्यमानाम् ताम् शूरैः उद्वहन उचितैः ॥४-२५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: ādāya śibikām tāraḥ sa tu paryāpayat punaḥ ।vānaraiḥ uhyamānām tām śūraiḥ udvahana ucitaiḥ ॥4-25-21॥

translations.english: Tara jumped in on to the litter carried by strong monkeys.

verses.sloka: दिव्याम् भद्र आसन युताम् शिबिकाम् स्यंदन उपमम् ।पक्षि कर्मभिः आचित्राम् द्रुम कर्म विभूषिताम् ॥४-२५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: divyām bhadra āsana yutām śibikām syaṁdana upamam ।pakṣi karmabhiḥ ācitrām druma karma vibhūṣitām ॥4-25-22॥

translations.english: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: अचिताम् चित्र पत्तीभिः सुनिविष्टाम् समंततः ।विमानम् इव सिद्धानाम् जाल वात आयान आयुताम् ॥४-२५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: acitām citra pattībhiḥ suniviṣṭām samaṁtataḥ ।vimānam iva siddhānām jāla vāta āyāna āyutām ॥4-25-23॥

translations.english: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: सुनियुक्तानाम् विशालाम् च सुकृताम् शिल्पिभिः कृतात् ।दारु पर्वतकोपेताम् चारु कर्म परिष्कृताम् ॥४-२५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: suniyuktānām viśālām ca sukṛtām śilpibhiḥ kṛtāt ।dāru parvatakopetām cāru karma pariṣkṛtām ॥4-25-24॥

translations.english: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: वर आभरण हारैः च चित्र माल्य उपशोभिताम् ।गुहागहन संच्छन्नाम् रक्त चन्दन भूषिताम् ॥४-२५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: vara ābharaṇa hāraiḥ ca citra mālya upaśobhitām ।guhāgahana saṁcchannām rakta candana bhūṣitām ॥4-25-25॥

translations.english: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: पुष्प ओघैः समभिच्छन्नाम् पद्म मालाभिः एव च ।तरुण आदित्य वर्णाभिः भ्राजमानभिः आवृताम् ॥४-२५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa oghaiḥ samabhicchannām padma mālābhiḥ eva ca ।taruṇa āditya varṇābhiḥ bhrājamānabhiḥ āvṛtām ॥4-25-26॥

translations.english: Seeing the palanquin, Rama said to Lakshmana 'Let the body of Vali be placed in the palanquin quickly and last rites duly performed'.

verses.sloka: ईदृशी शिबिकाम् दृष्ट्वा रमो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ।क्षिप्रम् विनीयताम् वली प्रेत कार्यम् विधीयताम् ॥४-२५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśī śibikām dṛṣṭvā ramo lakṣmaṇam abravīt ।kṣipram vinīyatām valī preta kāryam vidhīyatām ॥4-25-27॥

translations.english: Then Sugriva along with Angada, crying aloud bitterly, lifted the body (of Vali) and placed it on the palanquin.

verses.sloka: ततो वालिनम् उद्यम्य सुग्रीवः शिबिकाम् तदा ।आरोपयत विक्रोशन् अंगदेन सह एव तु ॥४-२५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tato vālinam udyamya sugrīvaḥ śibikām tadā ।āropayata vikrośan aṁgadena saha eva tu ॥4-25-28॥

translations.english: Vali's deadbody was placed on the palanquin, decorated with many ornaments, garlands and clothes

verses.sloka: आरोप्य शिबिकाम् चैव वालिनम् गत जीवितम् ।अलंकारैः च विविधैः माल्यैः वस्त्रैः च भूषितम् ॥४-२५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: āropya śibikām caiva vālinam gata jīvitam ।alaṁkāraiḥ ca vividhaiḥ mālyaiḥ vastraiḥ ca bhūṣitam ॥4-25-29॥

translations.english: King Sugriva, lord of the monkeys, said, 'Let the funeral rites of my noble sire be performed in a fitting manner'.

verses.sloka: आज्ञापयत् तदा राजा सुग्रीवः प्लवग ईश्वरः ।और्ध्व देहिकम् आर्यस्य क्रियताम् अनुरूपतः ॥४-२५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: ājñāpayat tadā rājā sugrīvaḥ plavaga īśvaraḥ ।aurdhva dehikam āryasya kriyatām anurūpataḥ ॥4-25-30॥

translations.english: 'Let the monkeys march in front, showering many different gems in large quantities and let the palanquin follow.

verses.sloka: विश्राणयन्तो रत्नानि विविधानि बहूनि च ।अग्रतः प्लवगा यान्तु शिबिका तद् अनंतरम् ॥४-२५-३१॥
verses.transliteration: viśrāṇayanto ratnāni vividhāni bahūni ca ।agrataḥ plavagā yāntu śibikā tad anaṁtaram ॥4-25-31॥

translations.english: 'Let the monkeys perform the funeral rites of our lord in an honourable way as expensively as has been done with regard to the obsequies of kings who ruled over this land.

verses.sloka: राज्ञाम् ऋद्धि विशेषा हि दृश्यन्ते भुवि यादृशाः ।तादृशैः इह कुर्वन्तु वानरा भ्रतृउ सत् क्रियाम् ॥४-२५-३२॥
verses.transliteration: rājñām ṛddhi viśeṣā hi dṛśyante bhuvi yādṛśāḥ ।tādṛśaiḥ iha kurvantu vānarā bhratṛu sat kriyām ॥4-25-32॥

translations.english: Tara, Angada and the other bereaved monkeys hastened to perform the funeral ceremony of Valiweeping.

verses.sloka: तादृशम् वालिनः क्षिप्रम् प्राकुर्वन् और्ध्वदैहिकम् ।अंगदम् परिरभ्य आशु तार प्रभृतयः तथा ॥४-२५-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tādṛśam vālinaḥ kṣipram prākurvan aurdhvadaihikam ।aṁgadam parirabhya āśu tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tathā ॥4-25-33॥

translations.english: Then all the female monkeys who were in his (Vali's) harem walked past the deadbody of Vali, crying again and again 'Alas, Oh hero'

verses.sloka: क्रोशन्तः प्रययुः सर्वे वानरा हत बान्धवाः ।ततः प्रणिहिताः सर्वा वानर्यो अस्य वशानुगाः ॥४-२५-३४॥
verses.transliteration: krośantaḥ prayayuḥ sarve vānarā hata bāndhavāḥ ।tataḥ praṇihitāḥ sarvā vānaryo asya vaśānugāḥ ॥4-25-34॥

translations.english: Tara along with other female monkeys followed their lord, crying pathetically.

verses.sloka: चुक्रुशुः वीर वीर इति भूयः क्रोशन्ती ताः प्रियम् ।तारा प्रभृतयः सर्वा वानर्यो हत बान्धव ॥४-२५-३५॥
verses.transliteration: cukruśuḥ vīra vīra iti bhūyaḥ krośantī tāḥ priyam ।tārā prabhṛtayaḥ sarvā vānaryo hata bāndhava ॥4-25-35॥

translations.english: When the female monkeys were weeping in the midst of the forest, it looked as if the forest and the hills were also mourning.

verses.sloka: अनुजग्मुः च भर्तारम् क्रोशंत्यः करुण स्वनाः ।तासाम् रुदित शब्देन वानरीणाम् वन अंतरे ॥४-२५-३६॥
verses.transliteration: anujagmuḥ ca bhartāram krośaṁtyaḥ karuṇa svanāḥ ।tāsām rudita śabdena vānarīṇām vana aṁtare ॥4-25-36॥

translations.english: Tormented with tears, the monkeys prepared in a solitary place surrounded by waters a pyre on the sandbank of a mountain stream.

verses.sloka: वनानि गिरयः चैव विक्रोशंति इव सर्वतः ।पुलिने गिरि नद्याः तु विविक्ते जल संवृते ॥४-२५-३७॥
verses.transliteration: vanāni girayaḥ caiva vikrośaṁti iva sarvataḥ ।puline giri nadyāḥ tu vivikte jala saṁvṛte ॥4-25-37॥

translations.english: Putting down the palanquin from their shoulders on the lonely spot, the bearers stood in tearswaiting.

verses.sloka: चिताम् चक्रुः सुबहवो वानरा वन चारिणः ।अवरोप्य ततः स्कंधात् शिबिकाम् वानरोत्तमाः ॥४-२५-३८॥
verses.transliteration: citām cakruḥ subahavo vānarā vana cāriṇaḥ ।avaropya tataḥ skaṁdhāt śibikām vānarottamāḥ ॥4-25-38॥

translations.english: Seeing her husband lying in the palanquin, Tara, full of grief placed Vali's head on her lap and cried.

verses.sloka: तस्थुः एकांतम् आश्रित्य सर्वे शोक परायणाः ।ततः तारा पतिम् दृष्ट्वा शिबिका तल शायिनम् ॥४-२५-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tasthuḥ ekāṁtam āśritya sarve śoka parāyaṇāḥ ।tataḥ tārā patim dṛṣṭvā śibikā tala śāyinam ॥4-25-39॥

translations.english: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?

verses.sloka: आरोप्य अंके शिरः तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता ।हा वानर महाराज हा नाथ माम् वत्सल ॥४-२५-४०॥
verses.transliteration: āropya aṁke śiraḥ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā ।hā vānara mahārāja hā nātha mām vatsala ॥4-25-40॥

translations.english: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?

verses.sloka: हा महार्हः महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम् ।जनम् न पश्यसि इमम् त्वम् कस्मात् शोक अभिपीडितम् ॥४-२५-४१॥
verses.transliteration: hā mahārhaḥ mahābāho hā mama priya paśya mām ।janam na paśyasi imam tvam kasmāt śoka abhipīḍitam ॥4-25-41॥

translations.english: 'O revered self even though you are bereft of life, your face looks cheerful. It carries the colour of the setting Sun, and looks the same when you were alive.

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टम् इह ते वक्त्रम् गत असोः अपि मानद ।अस्त अर्क सम वर्णम् च दृश्यते जीवतो यथा ॥४-२५-४२॥
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭam iha te vaktram gata asoḥ api mānada ।asta arka sama varṇam ca dṛśyate jīvato yathā ॥4-25-42॥

translations.english: 'O monkey a single arrow from Rama who appeared in the forest in the form of death dragged you away from us and turned us all into widows.

verses.sloka: एष त्वाम् राम रूपेण कालः कर्षति वानर ।येन स्म विधवाः सर्वाः कृता एक इषुणा रणे ॥४-२५-४३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa tvām rāma rūpeṇa kālaḥ karṣati vānara ।yena sma vidhavāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtā eka iṣuṇā raṇe ॥4-25-43॥

translations.english: 'O king of kings why don't you understand that these female monkeys, your wives who were dear to you have come on foot this long distance with great difficulty?
translations.hindi: इसने युद्ध में एक ही बाण में हम सब बंदरियों को त्रिधवा कर डाला । हे राजेन्द्र ! यह सब बंदरियाँ जिनको तुम सदा प्यार किआ करते थे, पाँव पाँव इतनी दूर चली आई हैं। इनको तुम क्यों नहीं देखते! अपनी प्यारी चन्द्रबदनी इप्सित भार्याओं को

verses.sloka: इमाः ताः तव राजेन्द्र वानर्यो अप्लवगाः तव।पादैः विकृष्टम् अध्वानम् आगताः किम् न बुध्यसे ॥४-२५-४४॥
verses.transliteration: imāḥ tāḥ tava rājendra vānaryo aplavagāḥ tava।pādaiḥ vikṛṣṭam adhvānam āgatāḥ kim na budhyase ॥4-25-44॥

translations.english: 'O lord of monkeys these moonfaced wives were indeed once your favourites. Why don't you look at them? Why don't you look Sugriva?

verses.sloka: तव इष्टा ननु चैव इमा भार्याः चन्द्र निभ आननाः ।इदानीम् न ईक्षसे कस्मात् सुग्रीवम् प्लवग ईश्वरम् ॥४-२५-४५॥
verses.transliteration: tava iṣṭā nanu caiva imā bhāryāḥ candra nibha ānanāḥ ।idānīm na īkṣase kasmāt sugrīvam plavaga īśvaram ॥4-25-45॥

translations.english: 'O king O sinless hero Tara and others, your ministers as well as the inhabitants of the capital are here sitting around you.
translations.hindi: ओर कपिराज सुप्रीव को तुम इस समय क्‍यों नहीं देखते । हे अनघ ! तार आदि दुम्दारे मंत्रिगण, ओर पुरजन तुमको घेर दुःखी हो रहे हें । हे अरिन्दम ! इन सब को जैसे सदा घथोचित रूप से विदा किआ करते थे, वैसे विदा करो

verses.sloka: एते हि सचिवा राजन् तार प्रभृतयः तव ।पुर वासि जनः च अयम् परिवार्य विषीदति ॥४-२५-४६॥
verses.transliteration: ete hi sacivā rājan tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tava ।pura vāsi janaḥ ca ayam parivārya viṣīdati ॥4-25-46॥

translations.english: 'O conqueror of enemies give these monkeys their due in accordance with their status and send them back as you used to do when they were passionately sporting in your company here in this forest.

verses.sloka: विसर्जय एनान् सचिवान् यथा उचितम् अरिन्दम ।ततः क्रीडामहे सर्वा वनेषु मदनोत्कटाः ॥४-२५-४७॥
verses.transliteration: visarjaya enān sacivān yathā ucitam arindama ।tataḥ krīḍāmahe sarvā vaneṣu madanotkaṭāḥ ॥4-25-47॥

translations.english: The griefstricken female monkeys helped Tara, overwhelmed with sorrow due to her husband's death, rise from the ground.
translations.hindi: तब हस सब काम से मत्त हो कर, तुम्हारे साथ यहाँ वन में बिहार करेंगी । इस प्रकार विलाप करती हुई और पतिशोक से विकल तारा को

verses.sloka: एवम् विलपतीम् ताराम् पति शोक परीवृताम् ।उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यः शोक कर्शिताः ॥४-२५-४८॥
verses.transliteration: evam vilapatīm tārām pati śoka parīvṛtām ।utthāpayanti sma tadā vānaryaḥ śoka karśitāḥ ॥4-25-48॥

translations.english: Then Angada, helped by Sugriva, placed his father's body on the pyre, with his senses numbed in deep sorrow.
translations.hindi: शोकविद्दल बंदरियों ने उठाया । तब अङ्गद ने सुग्रीव के साथ रोते रोते शोकाकुल हो वालि को चिता के ऊपर रखा और विधि- बत्‌ प्रदक्षिणा कर चिता में आग दी

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवेण ततः सार्धम् अंगदः पितरम् रुदन् ।चिताम् आरोपयामास शोकेन अभिप्लुत इन्द्रियः ॥४-२५-४९॥
verses.transliteration: sugrīveṇa tataḥ sārdham aṁgadaḥ pitaram rudan ।citām āropayāmāsa śokena abhipluta indriyaḥ ॥4-25-49॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with sorrow, he offered fire to the father who had set out on a long journey (to heaven). As per tradition he went round the pyre anteclock wise.

verses.sloka: ततो अग्निम् विधिवत् दत्त्वा सो अपसव्यम् चकार ह ।पितरम् दीर्घम् अध्वानम् प्रस्थितम् व्याकुल इन्द्रियः ॥४-२५-५०॥
verses.transliteration: tato agnim vidhivat dattvā so apasavyam cakāra ha ।pitaram dīrgham adhvānam prasthitam vyākula indriyaḥ ॥4-25-50॥

translations.english: The monkeys set Vali's body to be consumed by fire as per tradition and proceeded to an auspicious river of pure water in order to offer oblation (to the departed soul).
translations.hindi: उस समय पिता को महायात्रा करते देख अङ्गद बहुत विकल हुआ । इस प्रकार उन बानरों ने विधिपूर्वक बालि का अम्निसंस्कार किआ

verses.sloka: संस्कृत्य वालिनम् तम् तु विधिवत् प्लवगर्षभाः ।आजग्मुः उदकम् कर्तुम् नदीम् शुभ जलाम् शिवाम् ॥४-२५-५१॥
verses.transliteration: saṁskṛtya vālinam tam tu vidhivat plavagarṣabhāḥ ।ājagmuḥ udakam kartum nadīm śubha jalām śivām ॥4-25-51॥

translations.english: Then the monkeys along with Sugriva and Tara positioning Angada in the forefront made waterofferings (to Vali) collectively.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर वे वालि को जलाञ्मलि देने के लिए शीतल एवं निमेल जल वाली नदी के तट पर पहुँचे । वहाँ अङ्गद को आगे कर, सुग्रीब ने तार तथा अन्य बानरों सहित वालि को जलाञ्जलि दी

verses.sloka: ततः ते सहिताः तत्र हि सः अंगदम् स्थाप्य च अग्रतः ।सुग्रीव तारा सहिताः सिषिचुः वानरा जलम् ॥४-२५-५२॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ te sahitāḥ tatra hi saḥ aṁgadam sthāpya ca agrataḥ ।sugrīva tārā sahitāḥ siṣicuḥ vānarā jalam ॥4-25-52॥

translations.english: Mighty Rama, who was equally sorrowful and pitiable as Sugriva, directed the performance of funeral rites.
translations.hindi: महाबली श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने सुग्रीव की तरह शोकाकुल और उदास हो, वालि का प्रेतकार्ये करवाया

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवेण एव दीनेन दीनो भूत्वा महाबलः ।समान शोकः काकुत्स्थः प्रेत कार्याणि अकारयत् ॥४-२५-५३॥
verses.transliteration: sugrīveṇa eva dīnena dīno bhūtvā mahābalaḥ ।samāna śokaḥ kākutsthaḥ preta kāryāṇi akārayat ॥4-25-53॥

translations.english: Then, having set alight that Vali of foremost manhood, of might equal to blazing fire, slain by the shaft of the best of the Ikshvakus, the vanara approached Rama along with Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: इति पञ्चविंशः सर्ग; | तद्नन्तर अति बलवान्‌ श्रीराम जी के एक ही बाण से निहत, प्रदीप्त अग्नि तुल्य तेजस्वी वालि का प्रेतकार्ये कर, सुप्रीव लक्ष्मण: सहित वहाँ आए जहाँ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी थे

verses.sloka: ततो अथ तम् वालिनम् अग्र्य पौरुषम्प्रकाशम् इक्ष्वाकु वर इषुणा हतम् ।प्रदीप्य दीप्त अग्नि सम ओजसम् तदास लक्ष्मणम् रामम् उपेयवान् हरिः ॥४-२५-५४॥
verses.transliteration: tato atha tam vālinam agrya pauruṣamprakāśam ikṣvāku vara iṣuṇā hatam ।pradīpya dīpta agni sama ojasam tadāsa lakṣmaṇam rāmam upeyavān hariḥ ॥4-25-54॥
